findings.title: float:right on flex item is ignored so small-action button loses right alignment
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss .small-action is now a flex container via flexbox(). Per CSS Flexbox spec, float has no effect on a flex item. The button rule still uses float: right to push the dismiss/close button to the far right, so after this change it will be laid out as the next flex item directly after .small-action-desc instead of at the right edge. The fix is margin-left: auto on the button or justify-content on the container.

findings.title: order mixin off-by-one for legacy box-ordinal-group
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss the order($val) mixin emits -webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val and -moz-box-ordinal-group: $val. Legacy box ordinal-group is 1-based while modern order is 0-based, so the correct mapping is ordinal-group = order + 1. Emitting the same value orders legacy WebKit/Firefox differently than modern browsers, breaking the intended order(2) vs order(3) relationship used for .extra-info-wrapper and .panel in old browsers.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid -ms-align-items property
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss align-items() outputs -ms-align-items: $alignment. No such CSS property exists; IE10 flexbox only uses -ms-flex-align. The declaration is dead code that bloats every use of align-items(center/baseline) and can confuse future maintenance. It should be removed, leaving -ms-flex-align plus standard align-items.
